# Workspace agent: `graph-manager agent` and RemoteWorkspaceHost ## What to build The workspace agent serves every `WorkspaceHost` operation over HTTP JSON under `/agent/v1/*`, plus PTYs as a WebSocket `/agent/v1/pty/:id` and a run-page proxy `/agent/v1/view/:workspaceId/:runId/*`, all behind `Authorization: Bearer `. It runs inside a session or run container and uses `LocalWorkspaceHost` internally, so its behaviour is identical to local mode. `RemoteWorkspaceHost(url, token)` is the client: it implements `WorkspaceHost` by calling the agent. The shared contract suite (`hostContractSuite`) must pass against `RemoteWorkspaceHost` talking to an in-process agent, and a dist test starts the real `graph-manager agent` process. Nothing under `packages/graph-execution/src` may change. The workspace-host task (dependency, merged) created: - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/host/types.ts`: `RepoRef`, `GitAuth`, `BranchChoice`, `PrepareTarget`, `PtyProcess`, `EngineStart`, `FileStat`, `HostActivity`, `WorkspaceHost` (with `kind`, `prepare`, `spawnPty`, `startEngine` (+`resumeRunId`), `readFile`, `stat`, `listFiles`, `listRuns`, `runDetail`, `git` (+`opts.onStderr`), `activity`, `changes`, `save` (+`auth`, `filter`), `discard`, `loginFiles`, `pushBranch` (+`opts.auth`)) and `class HostError(status, message)`. - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/host/local.ts`: `LocalWorkspaceHost` (options `workspacesDir`, `graphExecutionBin`, `dataDir?`, `binDir?`, `reviewersFile?`, `env?`, `shell?`, `loginHome?`, `forgeAuth?`) and `isSecretPath`. - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/host/contract.ts`: `hostContractSuite(name, makeHost)` where `makeHost(env: { workspacesDir, loginHome, graphExecutionBin }) => Promise<{ host, close() }>`; `host/local.test.ts` runs it for the local host. - `AppContext.hostFor(workspaceId, user)` and the `HostError` branch of the app error handler. Read those files first; they are the source of truth for the method shapes. ## Context: files to read before implementing - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/host/types.ts`, `host/local.ts`, `host/contract.ts`, `host/local.test.ts` — the interface and the suite to reuse. - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/terminals.ts` (lines 25–28 client message schema, 129–158 the `{ websocket: true }` route) — the PTY WebSocket protocol to mirror (`{type:"data"|"exit"}` out, `{type:"input"|"resize"}` in). - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/app.ts` (lines 104–140) — how Fastify, `@fastify/websocket` and the error handler are set up; the agent is a separate, much smaller Fastify app. - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/proxy.ts` (lines 11–13, 67–121) — the run-page proxy; extract its streaming part into a shared helper for the agent's view proxy. - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/runs.ts` (lines 165–178 `localPage`/`livePage`, 580 `runDirOf`) — finding a run's page inside the container. - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/terminals.ts` (line 104 `STRIPPED_ENV`) — add `GM_AGENT_TOKEN`. - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/main.ts` (lines 64–79) and `is-main.ts` — how the server entry runs; `apps/graph-manager/package.json` (no `bin` today). - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/cli.ts` and the `bin` field of `apps/graph-manager/package.json` — created by the accounts task, which may run in parallel with this one: if they exist, add the `agent` subcommand to that dispatcher; if not, create them (shape below). - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/auth.ts` — the timing-safe compare pattern for secrets. - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/mcp.dist.test.ts` (lines 1–30) — how a test runs a built dist file and skips until `npm run build -w graph-manager` made it. - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/bundle-imports.test.ts` — server code may only import the engine's dependencies: `ws` is NOT allowed. Use Node's global `fetch` and global `WebSocket` (Node 22, CI uses 22; undici accepts `new WebSocket(url, { headers: { authorization } })`, verified). ## Patterns to follow **Agent API (all JSON; every route except healthz needs the bearer token; errors are `{ "error": string }` with the `HostError` status, 400 for a bad body, 401 for auth):** | Method & path | Body / query | Answer | |---|---|---| | `GET /agent/v1/healthz` (no token) | – | `{"ok":true}` | | `POST /agent/v1/prepare` | the `prepare` param object | `{ workspaceId, branch }` | | `POST /agent/v1/pty` | `{ workspaceId, argv, env, cols, rows }` | `{ id, pid }` | | `GET /agent/v1/pty/:id` (WebSocket) | client→agent `{type:"input",data}`, `{type:"resize",cols,rows}`, `{type:"kill",signal?}`; agent→client `{type:"data",data}`, `{type:"exit",code}` | – | | `POST /agent/v1/engine/start` | `{ workspaceId, args, env, timeoutMs, resumeRunId? }` | `EngineStart` | | `POST /agent/v1/file` | `{ workspaceId, path }` | `{ text }`, or 404 `{"error":"not found"}` → client returns undefined | | `POST /agent/v1/stat` | `{ workspaceId, path }` | `FileStat`, or 404 → undefined | | `POST /agent/v1/files` | `{ workspaceId, path, glob? }` | `{ files: string[] }` | | `POST /agent/v1/runs` | `{ workspaceId }` | `{ runs: RunSummary[] }` | | `POST /agent/v1/run` | `{ workspaceId, runId }` | `RunDetail`, or 404 → undefined | | `POST /agent/v1/git` | `{ workspaceId, args }` | `{ exitCode, stdout, stderr }` (client calls `onStderr(stderr)` once at the end when given) | | `GET /agent/v1/activity` | – | `HostActivity` | | `POST /agent/v1/changes` | `{ workspaceId }` | `{ changes: string[] }` | | `POST /agent/v1/save` | `{ workspaceId, branch, message, auth? }` (`filter` never crosses the wire; the agent applies `isSecretPath`) | `{ pushed, skipped, error? }` | | `POST /agent/v1/discard` | `{ workspaceId }` | 204 | | `POST /agent/v1/login-files` | `{ op, providers, files? }` | `{ files }` | | `POST /agent/v1/push-branch` | `{ workspaceId, auth? }` | `{ ok, error? }` | | `ALL /agent/v1/view/:workspaceId/:runId/*` | proxied to the run's local page (streaming, SSE included) | upstream response, 404 `{"error":"the run's page is not running"}` | Validate every body with zod (`.strict()` objects, like `createBody` in routes/terminals.ts lines 11–21). Bodies may be large (git output, login files): set `bodyLimit: 16 * 1024 * 1024` on the agent's Fastify. **Auth hook (constant time):** ```ts const want = createHash("sha256").update(`Bearer ${token}`).digest(); app.addHook("onRequest", async (req, reply) => { if (req.url === "/agent/v1/healthz") return; const got = createHash("sha256").update(String(req.headers.authorization ?? "")).digest(); if (!timingSafeEqual(got, want)) return reply.code(401).send({ error: "unauthorized" }); }); ``` Register the view-proxy `onRequest` hook AFTER this one (as proxy.ts relies on auth running first). Unknown paths answer 401 without a token and 404 with one. **PTY over WebSocket:** `POST /agent/v1/pty` spawns through the inner `LocalWorkspaceHost.spawnPty`, stores `{ proc, buffered: string[], socket? }` under a random id, and buffers output (cap 256 KiB, like `SCROLLBACK_MAX`) until the socket attaches; on attach flush the buffer, then stream. One socket per PTY (a second attach closes with code 4409). When the socket closes, kill the PTY and forget it; when the PTY exits, send `{type:"exit",code}` and close the socket after it. Unknown id → close 4404 (mirror routes/terminals.ts lines 131–134). **RemoteWorkspaceHost (`src/server/host/remote.ts`):** ```ts export class RemoteWorkspaceHost implements WorkspaceHost { readonly kind = "remote"; constructor(readonly url: string, private readonly token: string) {} private async call(method: "GET" | "POST", path: string, body?: unknown, opts: { notFoundUndefined?: boolean } = {}): Promise { /* fetch with authorization; network error → HostError(502, `the workspace agent at ${this.url} did not answer: ${msg}`); 404 with notFoundUndefined → undefined; non-2xx → HostError(res.status, json.error ?? res.statusText) */ } /** For the control plane's run-page proxy (hosted runs): where to send `/runs///view/*`. */ viewTarget(workspaceId: string, runId: string): { url: string; headers: Record } { /* `${url}/agent/v1/view/${encodeURIComponent(workspaceId)}/${encodeURIComponent(runId)}`, { authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } */ } } ``` `spawnPty` POSTs, then opens `new WebSocket(`${wsUrl}/agent/v1/pty/${id}`, { headers: { authorization } } as unknown as string[])` (cast: the DOM typings do not know undici's options), waits for `open` (reject with HostError 502 on `error`/close before open), and returns a `PtyProcess` whose `onData`/`onExit` register listeners, `write` sends `{type:"input"}`, `resize` sends `{type:"resize"}`, `kill` sends `{type:"kill"}`, `pid` from the POST answer and `process` undefined. A socket that closes without an exit message reports `exitCode: -1`. **Proxy helper (proxy.ts):** extract lines 94–120 into `export function pipeToUpstream(req: FastifyRequest, reply: FastifyReply, target: { host: string; port: number; hostHeader: string; extraHeaders?: OutgoingHttpHeaders }, pathAndSearch: string): void` and use it from both `proxyRoutes` (unchanged behaviour: hostHeader `127.0.0.1:`, `x-graph-execution-token` when a sandbox token exists) and the agent's view proxy (target = `livePage(runDirOf({ path: wsPath }, runId))` inside the container; hostHeader `127.0.0.1:`). The agent's view proxy must also drop the incoming `authorization` header before forwarding. **CLI (`graph-manager agent --port

--workspaces

`):** `src/server/agent/cli.ts` exports `runAgentCli(argv: string[], env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv): Promise<{ url: string; close(): Promise }>`. Parse `--port` (integer 0–65535, default 7700), `--workspaces` (required), optional `--host` (default `0.0.0.0`, the agent listens for the control plane on the container network). `GM_AGENT_TOKEN` must be set and ≥ 32 characters, else throw `ConfigError("GM_AGENT_TOKEN is required (at least 32 characters)")`. Read the token, then `delete env.GM_AGENT_TOKEN` (and `process.env.GM_AGENT_TOKEN`) so no child (git, engine, shells) inherits it. Engine bin: `env.GM_GRAPH_EXECUTION_BIN ?? defaultGraphExecutionBin()`. `loginHome: os.homedir()`. Print `graph-manager agent listening on http://:`. Wiring: if `src/server/cli.ts` exists (accounts task), add an `agent` case to its subcommand dispatch calling `runAgentCli(rest, process.env)` and keeping the process alive (SIGINT/SIGTERM → close → exit 0, like main.ts lines 66–78). If it does not exist, create it in the same shape: `#!/usr/bin/env node`, `const [sub, ...rest] = process.argv.slice(2)`; `agent` → the agent; no subcommand → `startManager(process.env)` exactly as main.ts does when run directly; anything else → `console.error("unknown command: ")`, exit 2; guarded by `isMain(import.meta.url)`. Add `"bin": { "graph-manager": "dist/server/cli.js" }` to `apps/graph-manager/package.json` if missing. **Test pattern:** `host/local.test.ts` for the suite call; `mcp.dist.test.ts` for the dist process test (`describe.skipIf(!existsSync(CLI))`). ## Step-by-step tasks ### CREATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/agent/server.ts` - **IMPLEMENT**: `export async function startAgent(p: { port: number; host?: string; workspacesDir: string; token: string; graphExecutionBin?: string; loginHome?: string; hostImpl?: WorkspaceHost }): Promise<{ url: string; close(): Promise }>` — builds Fastify (logger off), registers `@fastify/websocket`, the auth hook, the view proxy hook, every route of the table calling `hostImpl ?? new LocalWorkspaceHost({ workspacesDir, graphExecutionBin, loginHome })`, an error handler mapping `HostError` → its status, `ZodError` → 400 (copy app.ts lines 107–111), others → 500 `{"error":"internal error"}`. Listens on `p.host ?? "127.0.0.1"` and `p.port`; `url` uses the real port. `close` kills every PTY and closes the app. - **IMPORTS**: `fastify`, `@fastify/websocket`, `zod`, `node:crypto`, `../host/local.js`, `../host/types.js`, `../proxy.js` (`pipeToUpstream`), `../runs.js` (`livePage`, `runDirOf`, `isRunId`). - **GOTCHA**: the workspace path for the view proxy comes from the same resolution the local host uses (`resolveWorkspace` or the project folder); answer 404 `unknown workspace` otherwise and 400 `invalid run id` for a bad run id. - **VALIDATE**: `npm run typecheck` ### CREATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/host/remote.ts` - **IMPLEMENT**: `RemoteWorkspaceHost` as above, one method per table row. `git(..., { onStderr })` calls `onStderr(result.stderr)` once when stderr is non-empty. `save` sends no `filter`. - **VALIDATE**: `npm run typecheck` ### CREATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/agent/cli.ts` and wire the `agent` subcommand (see CLI above) ### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/terminals.ts` and `host/local.ts` - **IMPLEMENT**: add `"GM_AGENT_TOKEN"` to `STRIPPED_ENV` (line 104) and delete it in the engine base env of `LocalWorkspaceHost.startEngine`, next to `GM_PASSWORD`. ### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/proxy.ts` - **IMPLEMENT**: extract `pipeToUpstream`; `proxy.test.ts` must pass unchanged. ### CREATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/agent/agent.test.ts` - **IMPLEMENT**: 1. `hostContractSuite("RemoteWorkspaceHost", async (env) => { const token = randomBytes(32).toString("hex"); const a = await startAgent({ port: 0, workspacesDir: env.workspacesDir, token, graphExecutionBin: env.graphExecutionBin, loginHome: env.loginHome }); return { host: new RemoteWorkspaceHost(a.url, token), close: a.close }; })` — the same suite as the local host, unchanged. 2. Auth: `GET /agent/v1/activity` without a header → 401 `{"error":"unauthorized"}`; with `Bearer wrong` → 401; `GET /agent/v1/healthz` without a token → 200 `{"ok":true}`; a WebSocket to `/agent/v1/pty/x` without a token fails (no open). 3. `RemoteWorkspaceHost` against a closed port → rejects with `HostError` status 502. 4. `loginFiles` round-trips the files of `LOGIN_FILES.claude` (`.claude/.credentials.json`, `.claude.json`) through the agent into its `loginHome`, and the files are mode 600 (skip the mode check on win32). 5. A `HostError` from the inner host keeps its status and message over the wire (e.g. the 409 dirty-clone message of `prepare`). 6. The view proxy: with a fake run page (an `http.createServer` on 127.0.0.1 answering `GET /state` with `{"runId":""}`, and a `.graph-execution//web.json` written `{ url, pid: process.pid, host: os.hostname() }` in a prepared workspace — check `readWebJson` in the engine's api for the exact file name and fields), `GET /agent/v1/view///state` with the token answers that JSON; without the token 401. - **GOTCHA**: PTY tests skip on win32 (`process.platform === "win32"`), like terminals.test.ts. ### CREATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/agent/agent.dist.test.ts` - **IMPLEMENT**: skipped unless `dist/server/cli.js` exists. Spawn `node dist/server/cli.js agent --port 0 --workspaces --host 127.0.0.1` with `GM_AGENT_TOKEN` (64 hex chars); read the `listening on` line for the URL; `healthz` answers `{"ok":true}`; `activity` with the token 200, without 401; kill it. Also: without `GM_AGENT_TOKEN` (or a 10-char one) the process exits non-zero printing `GM_AGENT_TOKEN is required (at least 32 characters)`. - **VALIDATE**: `npm run build -w graph-manager && npm test -w graph-manager -- agent` ## Acceptance criteria - [ ] `graph-manager agent --port

--workspaces

` starts with `GM_AGENT_TOKEN` (≥ 32 chars) and refuses to start without it with `GM_AGENT_TOKEN is required (at least 32 characters)`. - [ ] Every `/agent/v1/*` route except `GET /agent/v1/healthz` answers 401 `{"error":"unauthorized"}` without the right bearer token; healthz answers `{"ok":true}`. - [ ] `hostContractSuite` passes for both `LocalWorkspaceHost` and `RemoteWorkspaceHost` (same suite, no changes to contract.ts beyond what the agent needs). - [ ] PTYs work over `/agent/v1/pty/:id` (output, input, resize, exit code); `RemoteWorkspaceHost.spawnPty` returns a `PtyProcess` that `TerminalManager.createOnHost` can use. - [ ] `RemoteWorkspaceHost.viewTarget(ws, runId)` gives the agent's view-proxy URL and the auth header; the view proxy streams the run page. - [ ] `GM_AGENT_TOKEN` is not in a terminal's or an engine run's environment. - [ ] No new npm dependency (bundle-imports.test.ts passes); nothing under `packages/graph-execution/src` changes. - [ ] Tests pass: `npm test -w graph-manager -- agent host proxy` ## Validation commands ```bash npm run typecheck && npm run lint npm test -w graph-manager -- agent host proxy terminals bundle-imports npm run build -w graph-manager && npm test -w graph-manager -- agent.dist git diff --stat -- packages/graph-execution/src # must be empty ```
